title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for the Necessary Expenses of the Government of the Philippine Islands During the Fiscal Year Ending December thirty-First, Nineteen Hundred and Twenty-Four, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be respectively necessary, are hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not appropriated for other purposes, in compensation of
the service of the Philippine Government for the fiscal year ending December thirty-first, nineteen hundred
and twenty-four, unless otherwise stated.
See Printed Copy Volume 19 Public Laws Page 6 to 143

At the request of any Department head, the Emergency Board may authorize the transfer of any
unexpended balance of the appropriations for "salaries and wages" to any item under "miscellaneous
expenses" of the same Bureau or Office, if the interests of the public service so require it, any provision of
existing law to the contrary notwithstanding.

Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, no person shall be employed
under contract by the Insular Government unless this be authorized by an appropriation in this Act.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and twenty-four.
Approved, February 12, 1924, with the exception of the appropriations for the Executive, the Treasury
Bureau, and the Bureau of Commerce and Industry, which have been vetoed in their entirety.
